desc_zh: 路上踢到一块石头竟是灵石
desc_en: Kicked a rock on the road — turned out to be a spirit stone

desc_zh: 隔壁阿婆送来一篮青菜
desc_en: The granny next door brought a basket of greens

desc_zh: 二狗又来炫耀他突破了
desc_en: Ergou came by to brag about his breakthrough again

desc_zh: 下雨天关在屋里修炼格外安静
desc_en: A rainy day made for quiet indoor cultivation

desc_zh: 自家灵田的灵米熟了
desc_en: The spirit rice in your field has ripened

desc_zh: 难得偷懒晒了半天太阳
desc_en: A rare lazy afternoon spent in the sun

desc_zh: 今天炼出的丹药居然是圆的
desc_en: Today's pill actually came out round

desc_zh: 夜里看星星看出了点感悟
desc_en: Gained a little insight stargazing at night

desc_zh: 一只小灵狐在门口蹭吃蹭喝
desc_en: A little spirit fox came mooching at the door

title_en: A Letter from an Old Friend
desc_zh: 收到一封多年未见的同门来信
desc_en: Got a letter from an old fellow disciple

desc_zh: 赶路时摔了一跤悟了点平衡
desc_en: Tripped on the road and learned some balance

desc_zh: 下山赶集买了点日用
desc_en: Went down to the market for supplies

desc_zh: 对着月亮喝了壶小酒
desc_en: Had a jug of wine under the moon

desc_zh: 随手吃了个野果竟是灵果
desc_en: Casually ate a wild fruit — it was a spirit fruit

desc_zh: 帮村里老人挑了一天水
desc_en: Spent the day carrying water for an elder

desc_zh: 丹成时屋里飘起了淡淡金光
desc_en: A faint golden glow filled the room as the pill formed

desc_zh: 一拳把练功的石碑打裂了
desc_en: Cracked the training stele with one punch

desc_zh: 今早天地灵气格外充沛
desc_en: The world's qi felt unusually abundant this morning

desc_zh: 花了一天把洞府收拾干净
desc_en: Spent a day tidying up the cave dwelling

desc_zh: 想收个徒弟结果被嫌弃太菜
desc_en: Tried to take a student but was deemed too weak

desc_zh: 一位老人坐在路边说与你有缘
desc_en: An old man by the road said you share a fate

desc_zh: 老人让你帮他挑了三天柴
desc_en: The old man had you chop wood for three days

desc_zh: 老人传你一篇心法后飘然离去
desc_en: He passed you a technique and drifted away

desc_zh: 在草丛里捡到一颗温热的蛋
desc_en: Found a warm egg in the grass

desc_zh: 你把蛋揣在怀里暖了好几天
desc_en: You kept the egg warm for days

desc_zh: 蛋里钻出一只毛茸茸的小灵兽
desc_en: A fluffy little spirit beast hatched out

desc_zh: 天边乌云翻涌似有雷劫
desc_en: Dark clouds churned as if a tribulation neared

desc_zh: 雷劫只劈了棵树虚惊一场
desc_en: The lightning hit a tree — a false alarm

desc_zh: 夜里忽然想起了故乡的炊烟
desc_en: Suddenly missed the chimney smoke of home tonight

desc_zh: 一只流浪狗靠着你睡了一夜
desc_en: A stray dog slept curled against you all night

desc_zh: 看着院里的花一朵朵开了
desc_en: Watched the courtyard flowers bloom one by one

desc_zh: 给村里娃娃教了一下午认字
desc_en: Spent an afternoon teaching village kids to read

desc_zh: 下雪天围着炉子烤红薯
desc_en: Roasted sweet potatoes by the fire on a snowy night

title_en: Train the Body, Clear the Mind
desc_zh: 清晨对着院子打了一套拳法
desc_en: Ran through a set of forms in the courtyard at dawn

desc_zh: 搬了院里的大石头练力气
desc_en: Hauled the big stone in the yard to build strength

desc_zh: 和路过的武者切磋了几招
desc_en: Traded a few blows with a passing martial artist

desc_zh: 沿着山路跑了一个来回
desc_en: Ran a loop along the mountain trail

desc_zh: 蹲马步蹲到腿都在抖
desc_en: Held a horse stance until the legs shook

desc_zh:
今日修炼3小时。
发呆8小时。
成果：无。
desc_en:
Cultivated for 3 hours.
Stared into space for 8 hours.
Result: nothing.

desc_zh:
今日尝试突破。
结果：天道不同意。
desc_en:
Attempted a breakthrough today.
Result: heaven's will said no.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹。
炸炉一次。
进步明显。
desc_en:
Tried alchemy today.
Blew up the furnace once.
Clear progress.

desc_zh:
今日睡觉12小时。
修为毫无变化。
符合预期。
desc_en:
Slept for 12 hours today.
Cultivation: unchanged.
As expected.

desc_zh:
今日感悟人生。
感悟失败。
desc_en:
Tried to reflect on life today.
The reflection failed.

desc_zh:
今日打坐入定。
中途睡着。
算是入定了。
desc_en:
Sat down to meditate today.
Fell asleep halfway through.
Technically still meditating.

desc_zh:
今日扎马步。
腿抖到现在。
疑似有效。
desc_en:
Practiced the horse stance today.
Legs still shaking.
Possibly working.

desc_zh:
今日研读功法。
看了三页。
睡着两页。
desc_en:
Studied a cultivation manual today.
Read three pages.
Slept through two of them.

desc_zh:
今日下山买菜。
顺便修了个心。
菜忘了买。
desc_en:
Went down the mountain for groceries.
Did some soul-searching on the way.
Forgot the groceries.

desc_zh:
今日观想天地。
天地没理我。
desc_en:
Tried to commune with heaven and earth today.
Heaven and earth ignored me.

desc_zh:
今日修炼五分钟。
刷手机两小时。
比例合理。
desc_en:
Cultivated for five minutes today.
Scrolled my phone for two hours.
Seems like a fair ratio.

desc_zh:
今日闭关。
闭着，没关。
desc_en:
Went into seclusion today.
Eyes closed, door wasn't.

desc_zh:
今日挑战极限。
极限没动，我先躺了。
desc_en:
Tried to push my limits today.
The limits stayed put. I lay down first.

desc_zh:
今日参悟剑意。
剑没动，我开始反思人生。
desc_en:
Tried to grasp sword intent today.
The sword stayed still. I started questioning my life choices.

desc_zh:
今日喝了一碗灵汤。
味道一般，灵气没感觉到。
desc_en:
Drank a bowl of spirit soup today.
Tasted average. Felt no qi whatsoever.

desc_zh:
今日练拳。
拳头疼了，对手没找到。
desc_en:
Practiced boxing forms today.
My fists hurt. Never found an opponent.

desc_zh:
今日数灵石。
数到一半忘了数到哪。
重新数。
desc_en:
Counted my spirit stones today.
Lost count halfway through.
Started over.

desc_zh:
今日修炼有成。
成的是体重。
desc_en:
Made progress in cultivation today.
The progress was in body weight.

desc_zh:
今日清扫洞府。
灰尘没扫干净，先躺下了。
desc_en:
Cleaned the cave dwelling today.
Didn't finish. Lay down instead.

desc_zh:
今日望天发愁。
愁的不是天道，是晚饭。
desc_en:
Stared at the sky and worried today.
Wasn't worried about heaven's will. Worried about dinner.

desc_zh:
今日修炼内功。
内功没涨，内耗倒是涨了。
desc_en:
Trained inner cultivation today.
Inner strength didn't grow. Inner anxiety did.

desc_zh:
今日打坐感悟天机。
天机未泄，腿先麻了。
desc_en:
Meditated to sense heaven's secrets today.
Heaven kept its secrets. My legs fell asleep first.

desc_zh:
今日修炼如山。
如山不动，我也不动。
desc_en:
Cultivated like a mountain today.
The mountain didn't move. Neither did I.

desc_zh:
今日想突破自我。
自我没突破，午觉先突破了。
desc_en:
Tried to surpass myself today.
Self stayed the same. The nap broke through instead.

desc_zh:
今日炼气有成。
气没炼好，倒是攒了一肚子。
desc_en:
Worked on refining qi today.
Qi didn't refine. Gas accumulated instead.

desc_zh:
今日苦修不辍。
不辍的其实是发呆。
desc_en:
Cultivated tirelessly today.
What was tireless was actually the staring into space.

desc_zh:
今日参禅悟道。
悟到中午该吃什么了。
desc_en:
Sat in zen contemplation today.
Realized what to eat for lunch.

desc_zh:
今日修炼真气。
真气没成，真累了。
desc_en:
Trained true qi today.
True qi didn't form. True exhaustion did.

desc_zh:
今日观星悟道。
星星很亮，道理没懂。
desc_en:
Studied the stars for insight today.
The stars were bright. The insight wasn't.

desc_zh:
今日修炼有所突破。
突破的是今天的睡眠记录。
desc_en:
Made a breakthrough today.
The breakthrough was in today's sleep record.

desc_zh:
今日苦练身法。
身法没练成，先扭了腰。
desc_en:
Trained agility techniques today.
Technique didn't form. Tweaked my back instead.

desc_zh:
今日推演功法。
推演了一半，忘了下一步。
desc_en:
Worked through a technique manual today.
Got halfway through, forgot the next step.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹有成。
成的是一炉黑炭。
desc_en:
Made progress in alchemy today.
The progress was a furnace full of charcoal.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气稀薄。
稀薄的其实是我的耐心。
desc_en:
Cultivated today, qi was thin.
What was actually thin was my patience.

desc_zh:
今日打坐三个时辰。
睡了两个半。
desc_en:
Meditated for three hours today.
Slept through two and a half.

desc_zh:
今日苦思破境之法。
想出了一个，但忘了。
desc_en:
Pondered ways to break through today.
Came up with one. Then forgot it.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，进展神速。
神速指的是睡着的速度。
desc_en:
Cultivation progressed rapidly today.
Rapidly referred to how fast I fell asleep.

desc_zh:
今日炼体。
体没炼成，倒是出了一身汗。
desc_en:
Trained the body today.
Body didn't change. Sweated a lot though.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，心如止水。
止水原因是真的没动。
desc_en:
Cultivated with a calm heart today.
The calm was because nothing actually happened.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹失败。
但闻起来还挺香。
desc_en:
Alchemy attempt failed today.
Smelled pretty good though.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，灵台清明。
清明到忘了自己在修什么。
desc_en:
Cultivated with a clear mind today.
So clear I forgot what I was cultivating.

desc_zh:
今日修炼一整天。
一整天主要是吃饭和睡觉。
desc_en:
Cultivated all day today.
Mostly consisted of eating and sleeping.

desc_zh:
今日感悟天道。
天道沉默，我自言自语。
desc_en:
Tried to commune with heaven's will today.
Heaven stayed silent. I talked to myself instead.

desc_zh:
今日修炼颇有心得。
心得是：明天再说。
desc_en:
Gained some insight while cultivating today.
The insight was: I'll deal with it tomorrow.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵感如泉涌。
泉涌完就枯竭了。
desc_en:
Inspiration flowed like a spring today.
Then the spring ran dry immediately.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，状态极佳。
极佳到没起床。
desc_en:
Cultivation condition was excellent today.
So excellent I never got out of bed.

desc_zh:
今日观摩同门修炼。
观摩完更想睡了。
desc_en:
Watched fellow disciples cultivate today.
Watching made me want to nap more.

desc_zh:
今日苦修十二时辰。
十二时辰里十一个在摆烂。
desc_en:
Cultivated for twelve hours today.
Eleven of them were spent slacking off.

desc_zh:
今日终有突破。
突破的是今天摆烂的记录。
desc_en:
Finally had a breakthrough today.
The breakthrough was today's new slacking record.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，自我感觉良好。
别人没什么感觉。
desc_en:
Felt good about my cultivation today.
Nobody else noticed any difference.

desc_zh:
今日反思过去十年。
结论：白活了。
desc_en:
Reflected on the past decade today.
Conclusion: wasted.

desc_zh:
今日立志做个不一样的修士。
明天还是老样子。
desc_en:
Vowed to be a different cultivator today.
Tomorrow will be the same as always.

desc_zh: 今日总结：活着，但没怎么活明白。
desc_en: Today's summary: alive, but not particularly enlightened.

desc_zh:
今日突破失败。
天道：意料之中。
desc_en:
Breakthrough failed today.
Heaven's will: expected.

desc_zh:
今日反省。
反省到一半睡着了。
明天继续反省。
desc_en:
Did some self-reflection today.
Fell asleep halfway through.
Will continue tomorrow.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：修仙路漫漫，摆烂路更长。
desc_en: Today's realization: the cultivation path is long, the slacking path is longer.

desc_zh:
今日决定戒掉摆烂。
然后摆烂了一整天。
desc_en:
Decided to quit slacking today.
Then slacked off all day.

desc_zh:
今日明白了一个道理。
但忘了是什么道理。
desc_en:
Understood an important truth today.
Forgot what it was.

desc_zh:
今日重新审视人生。
人生没什么变化。
desc_en:
Re-examined my life today.
Life didn't change much.

desc_zh:
今日突破失败，寿元减少。
倒是没那么焦虑了。
desc_en:
Failed a breakthrough today, lost some lifespan.
Strangely less anxious about it now.

desc_zh: 今日想通了一件事：修不修仙都得吃饭。
desc_en: Realized something important today: whether you cultivate or not, you still gotta eat.

desc_zh:
今日给自己定了个小目标。
目标已经推到明天了。
desc_en:
Set a small goal for myself today.
Already pushed it to tomorrow.

desc_zh: 今日修炼，悟出一个真理：努力不一定有用。
desc_en: Cultivated today and grasped a truth: effort doesn't always work.

desc_zh:
今日想起了上一世。
上一世好像也没干成什么事。
desc_en:
Recalled my previous life today.
Don't think I accomplished much then either.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：天道无情，但请假应该批的。
desc_en: Today's insight: heaven's will is merciless, but it should still approve my day off.

desc_zh: 今日修炼，悟出长生不一定快乐。
desc_en: Cultivated today and realized immortality isn't necessarily happiness.

desc_zh:
今日反思：寿元没了才知道珍惜。
但好像晚了。
desc_en: Reflected today: only when lifespan runs low do you learn to cherish it. Bit late though.

desc_zh:
今日决定不再纠结突破失败。
明天还是会纠结。
desc_en:
Decided to stop dwelling on failed breakthroughs.
Will probably dwell on it again tomorrow.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：轮回这么多次，活明白的次数为零。
desc_en: Today's insight: this many reincarnations, zero times truly understood.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，忽然觉得人生没那么难。
然后又突破失败了。
desc_en:
Cultivated today, suddenly felt life wasn't so hard.
Then failed a breakthrough right after.

desc_zh: 今日想了很多，决定了什么都不做。
desc_en: Thought about a lot today, decided to do nothing.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：人生苦短，丹药管饱。
desc_en: Today's insight: life is short, but pills are filling.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，想起了死去的上一世。
然后接着摆烂。
desc_en:
Cultivated today, thought of my deceased past life.
Then kept slacking off.

desc_zh:
今日终于想开了：不突破也能活。
就是活得久一点而已。
desc_en:
Finally let it go today: you can live without breaking through.
Just means living a bit longer, that's all.

desc_zh:
今日决定坦然面对失败。
然后哭了一下。
desc_en:
Decided to face failure calmly today.
Then cried a little.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：天劫劈下来那一刻，什么道理都没用。
desc_en: Today's insight: the moment tribulation strikes, none of the wisdom helps.

desc_zh: 今日修炼，悟出修仙也是种打工。
desc_en: Cultivated today and realized cultivation is just another job.

desc_zh:
今日决定看淡一切。
然后为灵石的事又焦虑了。
desc_en:
Decided to let go of everything today.
Then got anxious about spirit stones again.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：摆烂久了，连天道都不来烦我了。
desc_en: Today's insight: after enough slacking, even heaven's will stopped bothering me.

desc_zh:
今日反思：突破失败不可怕，可怕的是没尝试。
但今天也没尝试。
desc_en: Reflected today: failure isn't scary, not trying is. Didn't try today either.

desc_zh:
今日终于理解了什么叫心如止水。
因为我真的什么都没做。
desc_en:
Finally understood what calm as still water means today.
Because I genuinely did nothing.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，想起自己已经死过好几次。
还是没想明白活着图什么。
desc_en:
Cultivated today, remembered I've died several times.
Still haven't figured out what living is for.

desc_zh:
今日决定不内耗。
内耗了一整天关于要不要内耗。
desc_en:
Decided not to overthink today.
Spent the whole day overthinking whether to overthink.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：修炼到最后，大家拼的都是心态。
desc_en: Today's insight: in the end, cultivation is really a battle of mindset.

desc_zh: 今日明白了：寿元和余额一样，越花越没有。
desc_en: Realized today: lifespan is like a bank balance, the more you spend, the less you have.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，想起小时候的梦想。
现在已经不记得是什么梦想了。
desc_en:
Cultivated today, recalled a childhood dream.
Can't remember what it was anymore.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：人这一生，至少要炸一次炉。
desc_en: Today's insight: in life, you should blow up at least one furnace.

desc_zh: 今日想清楚了：摆烂和修炼，本质上是一种平衡。
desc_en: Figured it out today: slacking and cultivating are, in essence, a balance.

desc_zh:
今日突破失败。
但我已经不哭了，进步明显。
desc_en:
Failed a breakthrough today.
But I didn't cry this time. Clear progress.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：所谓天道，可能也是临时工。
desc_en: Today's insight: heaven's will might just be a temp worker too.

desc_zh:
今日决定原谅自己今天没修炼。
明天大概也会原谅。
desc_en:
Decided to forgive myself for not cultivating today.
Will probably forgive myself tomorrow too.

desc_zh:
今日想到一句话：活着已经很不容易了。
然后接着躺着。
desc_en:
Thought of a line today: just being alive is hard enough.
Then kept lying down.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：突破失败的人，明天还是要吃饭的。
desc_en: Today's insight: even those who fail breakthroughs still need to eat tomorrow.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，想起这是第N次转世。
没数清具体是第几次。
desc_en:
Cultivated today, remembered this is reincarnation number N.
Lost count of the exact number.

desc_zh:
今日决定不再跟自己较劲。
较劲到现在还在较劲。
desc_en:
Decided to stop fighting myself today.
Still fighting myself as of now.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：寿元用完那天，希望我至少吃饱了。
desc_en: Today's insight: on the day my lifespan runs out, I hope at least I'm well-fed.

desc_zh:
今日想通：修炼是为了活得久，摆烂是为了活得好。
两者居然不矛盾。
desc_en: Figured out today: cultivation is for living long, slacking is for living well. Turns out they're not contradictory.

desc_zh: 今日感悟：突破失败这么多次，已经有了抗体。
desc_en: Today's insight: failed so many breakthroughs, I've built up an immunity.

desc_zh:
今日决定坦然接受平庸。
然后默默期待奇迹。
desc_en:
Decided to accept mediocrity calmly today.
Then quietly hoped for a miracle anyway.

desc_zh: 今日修炼，悟出一句话：活着，已经是种修行了。
desc_en: Cultivated today and arrived at a thought: simply being alive is already a form of cultivation.

desc_zh: 今日想起：寿元短，但丹药管饱，勉强算公平。
desc_en: Recalled today: lifespan is short, but the pills are filling. Roughly fair, I guess.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹时走神。
炼出来的不知道是丹还是石头。
desc_en:
Zoned out while making pills today.
Not sure if what came out was a pill or a rock.

desc_zh:
今日打坐，邻居家鸡飞进了院子。
打坐结束，鸡还在。
desc_en:
Meditated today. The neighbor's chicken flew into the yard.
Meditation ended. The chicken stayed.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，走火入魔了一下。
然后又走出来了。
desc_en:
Briefly slipped into a qi deviation today.
Then slipped right back out.

desc_zh:
今日突破时打了个喷嚏。
境界没涨，喷嚏挺响。
desc_en:
Sneezed during a breakthrough attempt today.
Realm didn't rise. The sneeze was impressively loud.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气突然消失了五秒。
然后又回来了，没人能解释。
desc_en:
Qi vanished for five seconds today.
Then it came back. Nobody can explain it.

desc_zh:
今日打坐，闻到隔壁炖肉的味道。
修炼直接结束。
desc_en:
Meditated today, smelled stew from next door.
Meditation ended immediately.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，加错了一种材料。
丹炉表示很意外。
desc_en:
Added the wrong ingredient during alchemy today.
The furnace seemed genuinely surprised.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵根突然震了一下。
事后查无原因。
desc_en:
Spiritual root suddenly trembled during cultivation today.
No cause found afterward.

desc_zh:
今日突破，雷劫劈中了旁边的树。
我毫发无伤，树没了。
desc_en:
Tribulation lightning struck the nearby tree during my breakthrough today.
I'm unscathed. The tree isn't.

desc_zh: 今日修炼，差点突破，被一只蝴蝶打断了。
desc_en: Almost broke through today, interrupted by a butterfly.

desc_zh: 今日炼丹炸炉，炸出了隔壁的猫。
desc_en: Furnace exploded during alchemy today, somehow flushed out the neighbor's cat.

desc_zh:
今日打坐，灵气突然变得格外浓郁。
浓郁了十秒，然后恢复正常。
desc_en:
Qi suddenly became unusually dense during meditation today.
Lasted ten seconds, then back to normal.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，丹田发热，以为要突破。
结果是吃多了上火。
desc_en:
Dantian felt hot today, thought I was about to break through.
Turned out I just ate too much spicy food.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，配方抄错了一行。
炼出来的东西暂时无法命名。
desc_en:
Misread a line in the recipe during alchemy today.
Whatever came out can't be named yet.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，感觉天地都在注视我。
后来发现是只乌鸦。
desc_en:
Felt like heaven and earth were watching me today.
Turned out it was just a crow.

desc_zh:
今日打坐，突然顿悟。
顿悟内容是该剪指甲了。
desc_en:
Had a sudden epiphany while meditating today.
The epiphany was that I need to cut my nails.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气波动剧烈。
后来发现是隔壁在放炮。
desc_en:
Qi fluctuated wildly during cultivation today.
Turned out the neighbors were setting off firecrackers.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，炉子莫名其妙自己灭了。
原因不明，丹倒是没炸。
desc_en:
Furnace mysteriously went out on its own today.
Cause unknown. At least the pill didn't explode.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，突然有种被注视的感觉。
回头一看，是自己的影子。
desc_en:
Suddenly felt watched during cultivation today.
Turned around — it was my own shadow.

desc_zh:
今日打坐，灵识忽然飘远了。
飘到了隔壁村，看了会儿热闹。
desc_en:
Spiritual sense drifted far away during meditation today.
Drifted to the next village, watched some drama unfold.

desc_zh:
今日突破，半路被一阵风吹倒了。
风：不针对你。
desc_en:
Got knocked over by a gust of wind mid-breakthrough today.
The wind: nothing personal.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵根突然有点抗拒。
大概是不想上班。
desc_en:
Spiritual root seemed resistant during cultivation today.
Probably just didn't want to work.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，丹炉发出奇怪的声音。
炉子：没事，习惯了。
desc_en:
Furnace made a strange noise during alchemy today.
The furnace: nothing to worry about, used to it.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，体内真气突然走错了道。
绕了一圈才回来，浪费了不少时间。
desc_en:
True qi took a wrong turn inside today.
Took a detour before finding its way back. Wasted some time.

desc_zh:
今日打坐，听到天边传来一声闷雷。
然后什么都没发生。
desc_en:
Heard distant thunder while meditating today.
Then absolutely nothing happened.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气浓度突然爆表。
后来发现是闻到了别人炼的丹。
desc_en:
Qi density spiked unexpectedly during cultivation today.
Turned out I just smelled someone else's pills.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，材料放反了顺序。
丹炉表示这操作很新颖。
desc_en:
Added ingredients in the wrong order during alchemy today.
The furnace found this approach quite innovative.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，突然有所感应。
感应到的是肚子饿了。
desc_en:
Had a sudden sense of something during cultivation today.
The sense was hunger.

desc_zh:
今日打坐，灵台一片空明。
空明到忘了自己在干什么。
desc_en:
Mind was completely clear during meditation today.
So clear I forgot what I was doing.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，体内真气突然不听话。
沟通失败，明天再谈。
desc_en:
True qi refused to cooperate during cultivation today.
Negotiations failed. Will try again tomorrow.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，邻居问我境界。
我说还在引气期。
他没再问了。
desc_en:
Neighbor asked about my realm today.
I said still Qi Drawing.
He didn't ask again.

desc_zh:
今日同门炫耀突破了。
我笑着祝贺，转身继续摆烂。
desc_en:
A fellow disciple bragged about breaking through today.
I smiled and congratulated them, then kept slacking.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，想象自己飞升的样子。
然后继续坐在原地。
desc_en:
Imagined what ascension would feel like today.
Then kept sitting right where I was.

desc_zh:
今日苦练，进步细微但存在。
细微到肉眼不可见。
desc_en:
Trained hard today, progress was small but present.
So small it's invisible to the naked eye.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，丹药颜色有点奇怪。
味道倒是出乎意料地正常。
desc_en:
Pill color came out a bit strange today.
Taste was surprisingly normal though.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，体力消耗巨大。
主要消耗在挪了挪坐姿。
desc_en:
Cultivation drained a lot of energy today.
Mostly from adjusting my sitting position.

desc_zh:
今日决定早睡早起修炼。
睡是真的，起没起来。
desc_en:
Decided to sleep early and rise early to cultivate today.
The sleeping part happened. The rising part didn't.

desc_zh:
今日修炼有了灵感。
灵感是关于晚饭吃什么。
desc_en:
Had a flash of inspiration during cultivation today.
The inspiration was about what to eat for dinner.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，体内灵气似乎多了一丝。
但也可能是错觉。
desc_en:
Felt like there was a bit more qi inside today.
Could also just be an illusion.

desc_zh:
今日打坐悟道，终有所成。
所成的是腰酸。
desc_en:
Meditated on the Dao today, finally achieved something.
That something was a sore back.

desc_zh:
今日扎马步两个时辰。
腿到现在还在抗议。
desc_en:
Held the horse stance for two hours today.
My legs are still filing complaints.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气感应略有进步。
进步幅度堪比蚂蚁爬行。
desc_en:
Qi sensitivity improved slightly today.
The improvement was roughly the speed of an ant.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，火候掌握得恰到好处。
唯一问题是材料放错了。
desc_en:
Got the flame timing perfect during alchemy today.
Only issue: wrong ingredients.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，想起自己当年的修炼目标。
目标已经模糊得快不记得了。
desc_en:
Recalled my original cultivation goal today.
It's grown so blurry I can barely remember it.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵根有反应。
反应是打了个哈欠。
desc_en:
Spiritual root reacted to cultivation today.
The reaction was a yawn.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，悟出修炼贵在坚持。
然后坚持着躺下了。
desc_en:
Cultivated hard today, realized persistence is key.
Then persisted in lying down.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，体内真气运转流畅。
流畅到差点睡着。
desc_en:
Qi circulation flowed smoothly today.
So smoothly I nearly fell asleep.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，丹药出炉，颜值在线。
功效未知，先摆着看。
desc_en:
Pill came out of the furnace looking decent today.
Effects unknown. Just admiring it for now.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，差点开窍。
然后又关上了。
desc_en:
Almost had a breakthrough in understanding today.
Then closed right back up.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，体内真气安静得出奇。
大概是也累了。
desc_en:
Qi inside was unusually quiet today.
Probably also tired.

desc_zh:
今日苦练身法，摔了三次。
第四次决定放弃。
desc_en:
Trained agility today, fell three times.
Gave up on the fourth attempt.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，闻起来很有信心。
炼出来后信心崩塌。
desc_en:
Smelled confident during alchemy today.
Confidence collapsed once it finished.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，思路异常清晰。
清晰到想起了所有没做完的事。
desc_en:
Mind was unusually clear during cultivation today.
So clear I remembered everything left unfinished.

desc_zh:
今日打坐，外面下雨，氛围感十足。
氛围有了，修为没动。
desc_en:
Meditated in the rain today, great atmosphere.
Atmosphere: achieved. Cultivation: unchanged.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气吸收效率提升。
提升到能看见，但量不大。
desc_en:
Qi absorption efficiency improved today.
Improvement was visible, but not by much.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，悟出一个道理：修炼急不来。
然后还是急了。
desc_en:
Cultivated hard today, realized you can't rush it.
Got impatient anyway.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵根有了新的反馈。
反馈内容是今天不想干。
desc_en:
Spiritual root gave new feedback today.
The feedback was don't feel like it today.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，新配方初次尝试。
效果存疑，但没炸。
desc_en:
Tried a new recipe in alchemy today.
Effects questionable, but at least it didn't explode.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气似乎对我有点意见。
具体意见不明。
desc_en:
Qi seemed to have some complaints about me today.
Specifics unclear.

desc_zh:
今日苦修一整天，进步看不见。
但至少汗流了不少。
desc_en:
Cultivated hard all day today, no visible progress.
At least sweated a lot.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，体内真气似乎更听话了。
大概是终于妥协了。
desc_en:
Qi seemed more obedient today.
Probably finally gave in.

desc_zh:
今日打坐，灵台澄澈。
澄澈到能看见自己有多无聊。
desc_en:
Mind felt crystal clear during meditation today.
So clear I could see how boring I am.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，材料新鲜，丹炉给力。
炼出来的丹，颜色有点黑。
desc_en:
Fresh ingredients today, furnace performed well.
Pill came out a bit black though.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气浓度正常。
正常到让人怀疑是不是在修炼。
desc_en:
Qi density was normal today.
So normal it's questionable whether anything happened at all.

desc_zh:
今日苦练，肌肉有了反馈。
反馈是酸痛。
desc_en:
Muscles gave feedback after training today.
The feedback was soreness.

desc_zh: 今日修炼，悟出一个细节，但记不清是什么。
desc_en: Grasped a small detail while cultivating today, but can't recall what it was.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，配方背得很熟。
执行的时候全忘了。
desc_en:
Memorized the recipe well today.
Forgot it all once it was time to act.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气波动平稳。
平稳到怀疑是不是没在运转。
desc_en:
Qi fluctuated steadily today.
So steady it's unclear if anything's actually moving.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，体力消耗适中。
主要消耗在叹气上。
desc_en:
Moderate energy spent on cultivation today.
Mostly spent on sighing.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，状态时好时坏。
大部分时间是坏的。
desc_en:
Condition fluctuated during cultivation today.
Mostly bad though.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，新手操作，全程紧张。
结果出乎意料地稳。
desc_en:
Felt nervous through the whole alchemy process today as a novice.
Result turned out surprisingly stable.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气吸收顺畅。
顺畅得让我有点不安。
desc_en:
Qi absorption went smoothly today.
So smoothly it's a little unsettling.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，悟出修炼如登山。
然后坐在山脚下不动了。
desc_en:
Cultivated today and realized it's like climbing a mountain.
Then sat at the base and didn't move.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵根震动幅度增大。
大概是吓的。
desc_en:
Spiritual root trembled more violently today.
Probably out of fright.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，火候掐得正好。
材料过期了，白忙活。
desc_en:
Got the flame timing just right during alchemy today.
Ingredients were expired. All for nothing.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，悟性似乎有所提升。
提升幅度等于没提升。
desc_en:
Comprehension seemed to improve today.
The improvement was roughly equal to no improvement.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，毅力值爆表。
毅力用在了坚持不起床上。
desc_en:
Willpower was off the charts today.
Used entirely on refusing to get out of bed.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气似乎更亲近了。
亲近到差点把我撞倒。
desc_en:
Qi seemed to grow closer to me today.
So close it nearly knocked me over.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，全程顺利。
顺利到结束后才发现忘了点火。
desc_en:
Alchemy went smoothly the whole way today.
So smoothly I realized only afterward I forgot to light the furnace.

desc_zh: 今日修炼，悟出一句箴言：修炼如做饭，火大了就糊。
desc_en: Cultivated today and grasped a maxim: cultivation is like cooking, too much heat and it burns.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，效率出奇地高。
高到自己都不敢信。
desc_en:
Efficiency was surprisingly high today.
So high I don't even believe it myself.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气有所回应。
回应内容暂时无法解读。
desc_en:
Qi responded to my cultivation today.
The response is currently undecipherable.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，新工艺尝试成功。
代价是炉子有点变形。
desc_en:
Tried a new alchemy technique successfully today.
Cost: the furnace got slightly warped.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，进展平稳，毫无波澜。
波澜倒是出现在午饭时间。
desc_en:
Progress was steady and uneventful today.
The only drama happened at lunchtime.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，悟出一句话：天才在于坚持。
然后没坚持下去。
desc_en:
Cultivated hard today, grasped a saying: genius lies in persistence.
Then didn't persist.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气感应到了某种召唤。
召唤是晚饭的香气。
desc_en:
Sensed some kind of calling through the qi today.
The calling was the smell of dinner.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，灵感突发，临时改了配方。
结果出乎所有人意料，包括我自己。
desc_en:
Sudden inspiration led to a last-minute recipe change today.
Result surprised everyone, including myself.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气有点不稳定。
跟我心情挺像的。
desc_en:
Qi was a bit unstable today.
Pretty similar to my mood, honestly.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，体悟到天道难测。
但晚饭时间是可以预测的。
desc_en:
Cultivated hard today, realized heaven's will is unpredictable.
Dinnertime, however, is very predictable.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气波动突然剧烈。
然后发现是自己打了个嗝。
desc_en:
Qi suddenly fluctuated wildly today.
Then realized it was just me burping.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，配方写错了一个字。
丹药味道因此变得很特别。
desc_en:
Misspelled one character in the recipe today.
The pill's flavor turned out quite unique as a result.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气感应到危险。
危险来源是自己没站稳。
desc_en:
Sensed danger through qi today.
The danger was just me losing my balance.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，悟出一个真理：休息也是修炼的一部分。
今天的真理特别多。
desc_en:
Cultivated today, realized rest is also part of cultivation.
Today had an unusually high number of realizations.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵气流转格外顺畅。
大概是因为根本没怎么动。
desc_en:
Qi circulation flowed especially smoothly today.
Probably because nothing really moved at all.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，新材料效果显著。
显著到把炉子染成了奇怪的颜色。
desc_en:
New ingredient had a notable effect during alchemy today.
Notable enough to dye the furnace a strange color.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，悟出修炼如人生，起起落落。
今天主要是落。
desc_en:
Cultivated today, realized it's like life — full of ups and downs.
Today was mostly downs.

desc_zh:
今日苦修，灵气吸收效果存疑。
怀疑只是空气。
desc_en:
Qi absorption results were questionable today.
Suspect it was just regular air.

desc_zh:
今日修炼，灵根传来一丝暖意。
大概是太阳晒的。
desc_en:
Spiritual root gave off a hint of warmth today.
Probably just from sitting in the sun.

desc_zh:
今日炼丹，全程小心谨慎。
小心到最后忘了倒材料。
desc_en:
Was extremely careful through the alchemy process today.
So careful I forgot to add the ingredients at the end.

desc_zh: 路边长着一株从没见过的草药，叶子的颜色不太对劲。
desc_en: A strange herb grows by the roadside. The leaves are an unsettling color.

desc_zh: 翻遍了所有炼丹笔记，依然没认出这是什么草药，但看起来应该没毒（大概）。
desc_en: Flipped through every alchemy note he owns. Still can't identify it. Probably not poisonous. Probably.

desc_zh: 管不了那么多了，丢进丹炉里试试看。
desc_en: Enough deliberation - into the furnace it goes.

desc_zh: 一声巨响，丹炉裂成了三块，眉毛也烧掉了一半。
desc_en: A deafening bang. The furnace splits into three pieces. He loses half an eyebrow.
column20: 那株来路不明的草药，最终把丹炉变成了三块碎片，也带走了半边眉毛。
column21: That unidentified herb ended up turning the furnace into three pieces, and half an eyebrow along with it.

desc_zh: 丹炉稳稳当当，竟然真的炼出了一颗成色不错的丹药。
desc_en: The furnace somehow holds and produces a surprisingly decent pill.
column20: 那株来路不明的草药，意外炼出了这一世第一颗像样的丹药。
column21: That unidentified herb unexpectedly produced this life's first decent pill.

desc_zh: 在山林间发现了不明野兽留下的爪痕。
desc_en: Finds strange claw marks in the forest underbrush.

desc_zh: 权衡了一下，觉得保命比逞英雄重要。
desc_en: Weighs the odds and decides survival beats heroics.

desc_zh: 豁出去了，正面迎了上去。
desc_en: Throws caution aside and charges in.

desc_zh: 一番激战后，野兽狼狈逃窜。
desc_en: After a fierce clash, the beast flees in disarray.

desc_zh: 虽然赶走了野兽，但也挂了一身伤。
desc_en: Drove the beast off, but not without scars.

desc_zh: 路过的商人遇上麻烦，开口借了一笔灵石。
desc_en: A passing merchant runs into trouble and asks to borrow some spirit stones.

desc_zh: 商人承诺日后归还，但日子一天天过去。
desc_en: The merchant promises to repay - but the days keep passing.

desc_zh: 商人竟真的信守承诺，连本带利还了灵石。
desc_en: The merchant actually keeps his word, repaying with interest.

desc_zh: 商人不知去向，这笔账只能算了。
desc_en: The merchant is nowhere to be found. The debt quietly dies.

desc_zh: 梦里有声音在低语，醒来后记不清内容，只剩下莫名的情绪。
desc_en: A voice whispers in the dream. Waking up, only a vague feeling remains.

desc_zh: 梦中的预感成真，修炼时灵光一闪。
desc_en: The dream's premonition comes true - a flash of insight strikes mid-cultivation.

desc_zh: 梦中的不安挥之不去，修炼时险些出岔子。
desc_en: The dream's unease lingers - cultivation nearly goes badly wrong.

desc_zh: 想了半天，大概真的只是个梦而已。
desc_en: After much thought, it really does seem like just a dream.
